summary: Docs-only, +134/-0, one new file; no strategy, OMS, config, migration or runtime change, so the review is factual accuracy against production evidence. EVERY LOAD-BEARING NUMBER RE-DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY FROM THE PRODUCTION DB AND LOGS, not accepted from the PR. Webull (live:orb) BUY orders 09-09 for FTFT/SUNE/YMAT = 54, matching the stated denominator, and the status split is cancelled/filled only with ZERO rejected rows, confirming 'zero Webull venue rejections among 54'. Webull ENTRY fills (side=buy, client_order_id NOT LIKE '%-ocoexit-%' to avoid the entry-vs-exit trap) = FTFT 5, SUNE 4, YMAT 4 = 13, matching the table exactly; column sums reconcile (7+5+12=24; 13+7+2+2=24; 22 slot identities + 2 suppressed = 24). Schwab v2 entry fills FTFT 6 + SUNE 5 = 11, matching 'Schwab filled 11 entry episodes', and Webull matched 9 of 11. THE CENTRAL CLAIM IS CONFIRMED BY TIMESTAMP: every Schwab entry fill has a Webull twin EXCEPT FTFT 12:10:08 and SUNE 13:07:16, exactly the two one-sided episodes named. YMAT has no Schwab entry fills, consistent with the all-day Schwab policy refusal. NOTE ON MY OWN METHOD: my first grep of these two strings returned zero because the logs are root-only and I ran as trader; that was a permissions false-zero, not an absence, and I re-ran under sudo before drawing any conclusion. SLOT-VOCABULARY CLAIM VERIFIED IN CODE: _SLOT_BY_SOURCE maps rth_resting/rth_resting_mirror/eh_resting -> 'resting' and reactive -> 'reclaim', so the fan-out slot vocabulary is genuinely distinct from the CW entry-slot vocabulary (first/reclaim) and the rested reclaim DOES collide with the first entry in fan-out identity space; the doc's 'same durable identity tuple ... slot=resting' is correct and is the real FTFT 12:10 mechanism. RECLAIM1 EFFECT CLAIM VERIFIED BY MUTATION at #933 head 45462812: the rested reclaim is refused by the slot!=first branch of _strict_first_rest_admitted and the reactive reclaim by an unconditional guard in _cw_v2_quote; deleting that reactive guard turns test_strict_mode_disables_the_reactive_reclaim_producer and the FTFT control red, so 'disables both reclaim producers' is controlled, not asserted. Recommendation 4's deploy-state caution is accurate; box SHA 72b13393 confirmed. ONE NON-BLOCKING GAP recorded for the author: recommendation 4 names only PR #930 as merged-but-undeployed when #928, #929 and #927 are also merged and undeployed on box 72b13393 - understated, not false. The line 'At capture time PR #933 was open, unpinned...' is a correct point-in-time statement for the stated 16:30 ET capture; #933 has since been pinned at head 45462812.
